acceptance.requirement: Platform SUPER_ADMIN is a separate platform role and does not require Agent, Membership or Organization.
acceptance.evidence: Unit, integration and E2E tests prove platform-only authentication and platform navigation.

acceptance.requirement: Organization ADMIN cannot access platform administration or mutate platformRole.
acceptance.evidence: Server-side authorization and mass-assignment negative tests pass.

acceptance.requirement: Organization team administration is tenant-scoped and foreign resources are not disclosed.
acceptance.evidence: Cross-tenant integration tests return safe authorization responses.

acceptance.requirement: The final active organization ADMIN cannot be demoted or suspended.
acceptance.evidence: Last-admin invariant unit and integration tests pass.

acceptance.requirement: A missing first platform owner can be provisioned without a default password.
acceptance.evidence: Bootstrap creates one normalized User with null passwordHash and SUPER_ADMIN.

acceptance.requirement: First-admin activation uses a short-lived, one-time, hash-only token.
acceptance.evidence: Token storage, expiry, revoke, consume and replay tests pass.

acceptance.requirement: Activation sets a compatible password, enrolls TOTP MFA, creates an MFA-verified session and redirects to platform administration.
acceptance.evidence: Integration and mobile E2E activation and MFA flows pass.

acceptance.requirement: Cookie roles are not trusted and current database roles and statuses are loaded on each request.
acceptance.evidence: Session and stale-role authorization tests pass.

acceptance.requirement: Platform and tenant audit records exclude credentials, raw activation tokens and sensitive case content.
acceptance.evidence: Audit sanitizer and secret-scan tests pass.

acceptance.requirement: Additive migrations deploy on an isolated Preview database, repeat as no-op and match Prisma schema.
acceptance.evidence: Migration fixture, repeated deploy and schema parity gates pass.

acceptance.requirement: Agent and Manager authentication and operational flows remain functional.
acceptance.evidence: Agent and Manager regression E2E tests pass.

acceptance.requirement: Platform and organization administration work on desktop and mobile without critical accessibility defects.
acceptance.evidence: Exact Preview screenshots and browser tests pass with critical and serious accessibility findings equal to zero.

acceptance.requirement: Role elevation invalidates old sessions and platform sessions can be explicitly revoked.
acceptance.evidence: Pre-promotion cookie and session-revocation integration regressions pass.

acceptance.requirement: Activation and MFA rate limits persist across application instances and fail safely on infrastructure errors.
acceptance.evidence: Persistent bucket integration and route-level 503 regressions pass.

acceptance.requirement: Invitation bearer values never enter query strings.
acceptance.evidence: Fragment transport unit and E2E flows pass.
